Soft Structure / design decisions

From brief to surface.

01

Brief

Build a calm contemporary range with clear SKU recognition, enough shelf contrast, and no default “all beige” wellness shorthand.

02

System

One tube, cap, type scale, and label grid. Color carries variation; the deep anchor preserves a consistent hierarchy across the set.

03

CMF direction

Matte soft-touch tube, ribbed mono-material cap, restrained one-color print, and diffuse daylight on a warm mineral surface.

04

Production check

Screen colors are directional. Ink, polymer, lighting, and finish change perception, so physical drawdowns and packaging samples remain essential.

About this study

Soft Structure is an original fictional design exercise created for ColorVerse. It is not a real cosmetics brand, client project, product claim, or item for sale. The product image is a synthetic design visualization and should not replace physical packaging prototypes.
